question: What disqualifying lack of devotion excludes a person from receiving this teaching?
premises: A person may be devoid of devotion to the kula.
A person may be deprived of devotion to the guru.
These conditions are presented as relevant qualifications.
inference: One lacking devotion to both kula and guru is an unfit recipient.
uncertainties: The grammatical role of the locatives depends on the following verse.
plain_english: Indeed, in one who is devoid of devotion to the kula and deprived of devotion to the guru.
